verdict.rationale: Lindy's docs say you describe a process once in plain language and Lindy saves it as a reusable skill that it invokes automatically, which delivers the core of generating a workflow from a prompt (lindy-docs-18, lindy-docs-6). Routines turn recurring work into scheduled or triggered automation (lindy-docs-19), and the daily brief is set up by prompting (lindy-docs-34). missing for 10: evidence of editing or refining an existing skill or routine via prompt, explicit docs showing routines are created from natural language, any view of the generated workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
